regions.original_summary: Clear impact state and dispatch special-room requests separately. Ordinary reload selects sound/life-loss behavior, resets transient player/spawn/display controls and rebuilds the checkpoint background. Grant temporary protection, reset objects and transient movement flags, disable the display and initialize camera/player from the selected checkpoint record. Temporarily replace stage/row for late-stage and life-loss cases while background pages upload. Restore ordinary selectors before recreating the spawn window. Continue the incremental background upload until complete, restore stage/row and map bank six to establish spawn cursors. Select ordinary or late-stage audio. Command $0A initializes stage-specific timer tiles and the sixty-tick divider; then update spawns and reactivate the player. Life-loss requests at $87 and above use a longer $B4 delay; ordinary transitions use $3C before the shared delay path.

regions.original_summary: Return from the vertical collision helper. Add unsigned 8.8 horizontal speed to the world-X fraction and 16-bit integer position. Carry is the page-crossing result used by collision wrappers. Subtract unsigned 8.8 horizontal speed from world-X fraction and 16-bit integer position. Borrow controls page crossing. Add the 8.8 vertical velocity to fraction and screen Y. Carry communicates vertical wrap to callers. Subtract the 8.8 vertical velocity from fraction and screen Y.
